description:
Das Spital Emmental sorgt mit Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten an den beiden Spitalstandorten Burgdorf und Langnau für die hochstehende medizinische Versorgung von 150 000 Einwohnerinnen und Einwohner – rund um die Uhr.

Im Spital Emmental tragen wir gemeinsam Verantwortung – auch für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie. In unserer KITA Ämmehüpfer am Standort Burgdorf betreuen wir Kinder unserer Mitarbeitenden liebevoll und professionell – vom dritten Lebensmonat bis zum Kindergarteneintritt. Zur Ergänzung unseres engagierten Teams suchen wir dich ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung als

Dein Aufgabengebiet

• Du betreust und begleitest die Kinder liebevoll und professionell auf beiden Gruppen
• Du gestaltest und planst den Gruppenalltag aktiv mit – orientiert am pädagogischen Konzept der KITA
• Du übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest verlässlich an deinen fixen Tagen und unterstützt das Team flexibel bei Bedarf
• Du bringst dich in Sitzungen und Kitaanlässe engagiert ein und trägst zum guten Miteinander bei

Das bringst du mit

• Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachperson Kinderbetreuung EFZ, Kleinkinderzieher:in oder eine gleichwertige, anerkannte pädagogische Ausbildung (gemäss Gesundheits-, Sozial- und Integrationsdirektion)
• Freude an einer abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit mit Fixpensum und Bereitschaft, bei Abwesenheiten im Team flexibel einzuspringen
• Eine aufgestellte, belastbare Persönlichkeit mit Teamgeist, Empathie und Humor – auch in lebhaften Momenten
• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ein wertschätzender Umgang mit Kindern, Eltern und Kolleginnen / Kollegen

Unser Angebot

All’Emmental Hospital condividiamo la responsabilità, anche per quanto riguarda la conciliabilità tra lavoro e famiglia. Nel nostro KITA Ämmehüpfer presso la sede di Burgdorf ci prendiamo cura dei bambini dei nostri dipendenti con amore e professionalità, dall'età di tre mesi fino all'inizio della scuola materna. GAV: Le nostre condizioni di lavoro si basano fondamentalmente sul contratto collettivo di lavoro (GAV) per il personale degli ospedali e delle cliniche bernesi. Gastronomia: Le nostre cucine a Burgdorf e Langnau lavorano soprattutto con prodotti stagionali, sani e locali. I dipendenti beneficiano di uno sconto e possono concedersi una variegata selezione di buffet. Sono disponibili anche forni a microonde per portare il proprio cibo. Il diritto umano moderno al centro: vogliamo essere un datore di lavoro moderno nei confronti dei nostri dipendenti e creare una buona atmosfera interpersonale in modo che i nostri dipendenti si sentano sempre al centro e a proprio agio. Parcheggio: i dipendenti possono utilizzare diversi parcheggi a seconda della posizione. L'accesso e la fatturazione avvengono tramite la carta Parkingpay. Occasioni: per promuovere la nostra cultura aziendale, concediamo ai nostri dipendenti un giorno libero. I colleghi dei diversi dipartimenti possono partecipare a una giornata dedicata allo sci, al ciclismo, alla moto, all'escursionismo, al divertimento, al mercatino di Natale o alla cultura. Sconti: nell'Intranet i nostri collaboratori trovano informazioni/link a numerose offerte interessanti e beneficiano di prezzi ridotti, ad esempio per piscine coperte, cinema, automobili o acquisti nelle farmacie regionali. With specialists at the two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, the Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents – around the clock. At Emmental Hospital we share responsibility – including for the compatibility of work and family. In our KITA Ämmehüpfer at the Burgdorf location, we look after our employees' children lovingly and professionally - from the age of three months until they start kindergarten. To complement our dedicated team, we are looking for you immediately or by appointment as The Spital Emmental, with specialists at the two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, provides high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents - around the clock. At Emmental Hospital we share responsibility – including for the compatibility of work and family. In our KITA Ämmehüpfer at the Burgdorf location, we look after our employees' children lovingly and professionally - from the age of three months until they start kindergarten. To complement our dedicated team, we are looking for you to be your area of responsibility immediately or by appointment
• You look after and accompany the children lovingly and professionally in both groups
• You actively shape and plan the group's everyday life - based on the pedagogical concept of the KITA
• You take responsibility, work reliably on your fixed days and support the team flexibly when necessary
• You are committed to meetings and daycare events and contribute to good cooperation This is what you bring with you
• A completed Training as a childcare specialist EFZ, early childhood teacher or an equivalent, recognized pedagogical training (according to the Health, Social and Integration Directorate)
• Enjoy a varied job with a fixed workload and willingness to flexibly step in when the team is absent
• A well-positioned, resilient personality with team spirit, empathy and humor - even in lively moments
• Good communication skills and an appreciative approach to children, parents and colleagues Our offer Holiday GAV Culinary Modern Human in the middle Parking Occasions Discounts

If the 25 to 32 days of vacation per year are not enough, you can check with us the possibility of unpaid vacation. Our employees also receive an additional day off for their birthday! Culinary: Our kitchens in Burgdorf and Langnau work largely with seasonal, healthy and local products. Employees benefit from a discount and can indulge in a varied buffet selection. Microwaves are also available for bringing your own food. Modern Human Right in the Middle: We want to be a modern employer towards our employees and create a good interpersonal atmosphere so that our employees always feel right in the middle and comfortable. Colleagues from different departments can take part in a skiing, cycling, motorbike, hiking, fun, Christmas market or culture day.
